text_block_list.text: As part of a Tracen Academy event, we visited a ranch with the students for hands-on farm experience.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Leave the ranch work to me! I used to help my mom out on the farm all the time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My, how reassuring♪ But as your senior, I'm gonna show off some totally radical skills of my own!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: (I totally fumbled at the dorm sleepover... so I've gotta redeem myself right here, no ifs, ands, or buts☆)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: First up is milking! Let's see, gently squeeze the udder and—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, barely anything's coming out...? Could the cow be feeling under the weather...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's better if you hold it closer to the base!
Then, apply pressure with each finger one by one—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right! It's coming out!
Thanks, Spe-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, I just thanked her so candidly……
As the big sister, I have to show my cool side too!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Next is feeding the cows, right!
Hang on, I'll bring the pasture grass!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa……!? Maruzen-san, you're so strong!
……But if you carry that much all at once—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, I can't see where I'm—kyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Maruzen-san is completely buried in hay……!
A-Are you okay!?

Even after that, Maruzensky seemed to be
spinning her wheels quite a bit—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm relying on Spe-chan way too much!
Alright, gotta do my best-est!

text_block_list.name: Ranch Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, to think they suddenly couldn't make it……
Whatever shall I do……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grandma, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Ranch Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I need to harvest the pasture grass today,
but there's no one around who can drive the tractor.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, ma'am.
If you'd like, I can drive it.
I'm always tearing up the road in my beloved ride, after all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa……! You're amazing at this, Maruzen-san!
The pasture grass is gathering up so fast!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's all for the lady's sake.
Something like this is an absolute piece of cake♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
……Though, isn't this a tad too slow?
With this baby, I bet we could step on the gas a little more……!
(*VROOOOOM!!*)
choice_data_list: Isn't the speed picking up way too fast!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought!
To think you could shift into such high gear……!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
With my driving technique, I'll make you
shine even brighter—let's roll, Trac-chan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was the ab-so-lute best!
A powerful, wild ride!
That thrill on the cornering was simply irresistible—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
……Wait, o-oh dear……?
Did I maybe go overboard again……?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
T-That was incredible!
To harvest all that grass in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Ranch Grandma
text_block_list.text:
That was over in a flash……!
Ain't that downright amazing, missy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe it wasn't very cool of me.
I ended up getting carried away……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Not cool? Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, you're playful, kind,
and so caring toward your juniors—you're a senior I truly admire!
choice_data_list: I understand why everyone looks up to you.
I understand why everyone looks up to you.
I'm glad I got to see your cute side.
I'm glad I got to see your cute side.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, you're playful, kind,
and so caring toward your juniors—you're a senior I truly admire!
choice_data_list: I understand why everyone looks up to you.
I understand why everyone looks up to you.
I'm glad I got to see your cute side.
I'm glad I got to see your cute side.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
……Fufu, ahaha!
I see, maybe I was just being a little impatient.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I really have to thank Spe-chan and the others.
After all, hearing that they look up to me makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, did I pierce right through your heart?
Don't blame me if you fall completely head over heels for this big sister♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
……Just kidding! Still, I really do want to be a totally groovy big sister.
I've got to live up to my juniors' expectations, right!
